honest_limits: A self-check is the module's own claim about itself. Two large modules now prove their headline property on small honest fixtures; that is not evidence they work on real repositories.
PROVEN rose from 6 to 8 of 2,174. The titan census did not find a single broken module: the mass is unproven, not defective.

The futamura self-check measures a statistical guarantee, so it is seeded and deterministic but still a sample (400 trials at alpha = 0.05); a breach rate of 0.0175 is inside the bound, not a proof of it.
No external benchmark was run in this wave. Nothing here is a capability claim against any published system.
